title: Invalid airport id
why: Shows an empty Guid in the request is not accepted as an Id

steps.does: POST …/flight/airport with Id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, Name 'Narita', Address 'Tokyo, Japan', Code 'NRT'

expect: Rejected with a validation error on Id, or a fresh Id is generated instead of the empty one; no airport is stored under the empty Guid
